{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nebula-A''' was a type of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] equipped with [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. One of them served as [[Osten Dal'Nay]]'s flagship during his time as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Cularin Militia]]. It acted in a customs capacity, regulating traffic in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] after the system withdrew from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It would [[ionize]] and pull aside any ship that acted irregularly.
